item.title: One in six tested Amsterdam gardens contain unhealthy levels of lead
item.description: Of the 8,000 gardens in Amsterdam where the municipality did free lead checks, one in six was found to contain unhealthy levels of the heavy metal, Parool reported.

item.title: Vondelpark and surrounding streets declared nuisance area to curb crime and disorder
item.description: The city of Amsterdam plans to step up measures against rising "nuisance, intimidation, and drug dealing" in Vondelpark.

item.title: Amsterdam honors February strike 85 years after historic protest against Nazi occupation
item.description: At the 85th anniversary of the February Strike, Amsterdam Deputy Mayor Rutger Groot Wassink linked the historic 1941 protest to the modern struggle against fascism and intolerance.

item.title: Nearly one in ten Dutch consumers keep no cash at home, survey shows
item.description: A majority of people in the Netherlands have sufficient cash on hand for an emergency, according to research by De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).

item.title: Dutch nationals arrested in Spain during record cocaine bust
item.description: Spanish authorities have arrested several Dutch citizens as part of a large drug investigation, according to local media. A total of 12 people were detained.

item.title: Zoetermeer Alderman resigns amid alleged threatening calls to council members
item.description: Alderman Ronald Weerwag of Zoetermeer resigned Monday, just days before the municipal elections on March 18, following allegations that he used “intimidating, belittling, and threatening” language

item.title: Friesland politicians press schools to teach Frisian language to kids
item.description: All students in Friesland will be required to learn and actively use the Frisian language starting August 1, following a unanimous decision by the Provinciale Staten, NOS, and Omrop Fryslân

item.title: Over half of Dutch physiotherapists consider selling practices amid rising costs
item.description: More than half of the Netherlands’ independent physiotherapists are considering selling their practices as rising regulations and costs squeeze earnings, according to the latest Klein Bedrijf Index

item.title: Dutch households to spend less on gas, electricity in 2026
item.description: Households will pay slightly less for their energy bills this year.
